one_liner_ko: 음성 생성·음성 에이전트·오디오 API를 제공하는 AI 음성 인프라 플랫폼.
what_it_does_ko: ElevenLabs는 텍스트 음성 변환, 음성 인식, 보이스 클로닝, 대화형 에이전트, 생성형 오디오를 제공하는 AI 음성 인프라다. 코딩 없이 쓰는 웹 앱 ElevenCreative에서 내레이션·음악·더빙·효과음을 만들 수 있다. ElevenAgents로 전화·채팅·이메일·WhatsApp에서 응대하는 음성/채팅 에이전트를 구성·배포·모니터링한다. 모든 기능은 ElevenAPI(REST, Python·TypeScript SDK)로도 제공되며, 사용량은 모든 제품이 공유하는 크레딧으로 차감된다.
key_features: 보이스 클로닝·보이스 디자인, 1만 개 이상 음성 라이브러리

evidence.quote: ElevenLabs provides AI voice infrastructure: text-to-speech, speech-to-text, voice cloning, conversational agents, and generative audio.
Free AI Voice Generator & Voice Agents Platform | ElevenLabs
ElevenCreative is a no-code web application where creators, producers, and editors generate voiceovers, music, dubs, and studio projects directly in the browser.
ElevenAPI exposes every capability as a REST interface with official Python and TypeScript SDKs
Agents listen, read and interact just like humans would across phone, chat, email and WhatsApp.
Create controllable, expressive speech layered across 90+ languages.
Clone your voice, design one from a prompt, or explore 10,000+ voices from the library.
Generate studio-quality tracks instantly, any genre, any style, vocals or instrumental.
Create custom sound effects, soundscapes and ambient audio or search the SFX library.
The most accurate ASR model . Low cost and supporting speaker diarization and character level timestamps.
Expressive voices that bring audiobooks and podcasts to life.
Persuasive voices that drive action and brand recall.
Delivering real-time, multilingual customer support with voice agents
Monthly price and included credits per plan: Free $0 (10,000 credits); Starter $6 (30,000 credits); Creator $22 (121,000 credits, $11 for the first month); Pro $99 (600,000 credits); Scale $299
Annual billing works out to two months free — you pay for 10 months (annual price = monthly price × 10).
